name: Inland Center
summary: Bustling retail mall offering familiar stores, a kids' play area, restaurants & a casual food court.
description: Inland Center Mall is a regional shopping destination in San Bernardino featuring a diverse mix of stores, dining options, and entertainment experiences. The center offers convenient hours from 10 AM to 9 PM and hosts seasonal events including Santa Photos, making it a popular gathering place for the Inland Empire community.
demographics: Inland Center Mall primarily serves middle to lower-middle income families in the San Bernardino area, with a significant Hispanic and diverse multicultural customer base. The trade area encompasses value-conscious shoppers from the broader Inland Empire region, including young families and budget-minded consumers seeking accessible retail options. Typical visitors are drawn to affordable national chain retailers and practical shopping experiences, with household incomes generally below regional California averages.
